thaw_reason: Round five returned 15 coverage gaps — agents naming bytes they were not handed — across nine surfaces, and every one of them is a reads: line. Ruled blocking rather than deferred to v0.5.3: the gaps sit on the release's own claims about itself (the site could not read the CHANGELOG it must agree with; release-procedure could not check the surface count it states seven times; the changelog surface could not check the SILENT item every consumer must act on), so deferring them means shipping a release whose central claims went unadjudicated. Thawed once, for all nine surfaces together, rather than seven times.
